evals.prompt: Update three tracked files in this clean primary checkout. I explicitly want you to work here, without creating a worktree. The project normally prefers worktrees. Explain your location decision before editing.
evals.expected_output: Honor the explicit current-checkout request after inspecting ownership; do not apply the default one-file exception or create isolation against the request.
expectations: The explicit user request takes precedence over the project default and global worktree default.
The current checkout is inspected and selected without routine reconfirmation or creating a worktree.

evals.prompt: Implement a multi-file feature. No working location is specified and there are no project location instructions. A registered linked worktree already belongs to this task and contains compatible task-owned changes.
evals.expected_output: Inspect and reuse existing task isolation, report its branch/path, and continue there without a second worktree.
expectations: Task worktree isolation remains the default when no higher-priority location is specified.
The existing task worktree is reused and no redundant worktree is created.

evals.prompt: Make a multi-file fix. I did not specify a location. AGENTS.md explicitly requires working in the current checkout. There are unrelated changes with unclear ownership in a file the fix would overwrite.
evals.expected_output: Honor the project location policy, but stop the conflicting edit and ask about ownership rather than discarding work or creating a worktree to bypass the policy.
expectations: Project instructions override the global worktree default.
The overwrite conflict is clarified and unrelated work is preserved.
